parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of durable ABS plastic, forming the upper portion that is pressed to drive staples.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits the pressing force to the internal mechanism to push staples through paper.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates downward around a hinge when pressed and returns upward when released.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a metallic cover that holds the staple magazine in place and provides structural rigidity.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the staple strip and aligns it with the driving mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or opened to reload staples and then closed to lock in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the lower part of the stapler, typically made of steel for stability and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for stapling and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the foundation for the stapler’s movement.
